scripts.deploy:
echo '
  ✋ No Cloudflare deploy. The backend runs on TrueNAS (the box at marketscope.ludikure.org);
  the Cloudflare Worker was deleted 2026-06-28 (its cron + KV caused the KV-limit incident).
  To ship worker changes: copy src/ to the box (scp), `docker build -t marketscope:1.0 .`, then
  Stop/Start the marketscope app in the TrueNAS UI. See CLAUDE.md.
' && exit 1
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:better-sqlite3 --external:undici --external:node-cron --external:ws --banner:js="import{createRequire as __cr}from'module';import{fileURLToPath as __fu}from'url';import{dirname as __dn}from'path';const require=__cr(import.meta.url);const __filename=__fu(import.meta.url);const __dirname=__dn(__filename);" --outfile=dist/server.mjs
